body.statement: For every \(I\subseteq V\) and every pairwise disjoint \(A,B,C\subseteq V\), if \(\overline A\perp_{d,\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I}}\overline B\mid\overline C\), then \(X_A\perp_{P_I}X_B\mid X_C\).

source.verbatim_statement: If \([A]\) and \([B]\) are d-separated given \([C]\) in the mixture DAG \(D_{\mu}\), then \(X_A\perp X_B\mid X_C\) in the mixture distribution \(p_{\mu}\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Saeed, Panigrahi, and Uhler (ICML 2020), Theorem 3.2; apply it to the post-intervention component DAGs, whose mixture DAG is \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I}\).
